Package org.example.framework

Class IntersectionEngine

java.lang.Object
org.example.framework.Engine
org.example.framework.IntersectionEngine
public class IntersectionEngine extends Engine
The IntersectionEngine class manages the simulation of traffic intersections, handling events such as vehicle arrivals, departures, and traffic light changes. It extends the Engine class to utilize its event-driven simulation capabilities.

      public void setIntersections(List<String> intersectionTypeList)
      Sets the intersections based on the list of intersection types provided by the homeView.
      Parameters:
      intersectionTypeList - A list of strings representing the types of intersections to create. Valid types are "Bare Intersection", "Traffic Light Intersection", and "Don't show intersection".

    • setSimulationSpeed

      public static void setSimulationSpeed(double simulationSpeed)
      Sets the simulation speed factor. The simulation sleeps for (simulationSpeed * 100) milliseconds between events.
      Parameters:
      simulationSpeed - The simulation speed factor (must be greater than 0).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if simulationSpeed is less than or equal to 0.
